title: Add strict validation mode
description: Added --strict flag to validate command with completeness.py module.

title: Remove hardcoded assumptions from analysis code
description: Made tool a pure function: removed RPO assumption, made constraints explicit, added config errors.

title: Create Option B topology for comparison
description:
Plan included multiple options. Create topologies for:
- Option B: Satechi USB4 Slim NVMe + 8TB NVMe (silent, no redundancy)
- Option C: ThunderBay 4 mini + 4x 4TB SSDs (RAID10)
This allows comparison analysis between approaches.

title: Address capacity projection warning
description:
Analysis shows thunderbay-raid1 at 111% projected utilization in 12 months. Options:
1. Move some data to dedicated TM drive (currently under-utilized)
2. Plan for 3rd/4th SSD in ThunderBay empty bays
3. Adjust growth rate estimates if too conservative

title: Add Lexar SSDs and litestream enum
Implement Mac mini M4 storage hub topology
description: Created topology file: topologies/2025-01-29-mac-mini-m4-hub-option-a.yaml with Option A hardware (OWC ThunderBay 4 mini + 2x Crucial MX500 4TB RAID1), all datasets, and sync regimes.

title: Add RTO calculation to analysis
description:
Currently rpo_rto.py only shows max_rto but doesn't calculate achieved_rto. Should estimate RTO based on:
- Data size
- Restore bandwidth
- Recovery process complexity
This would make RTO analysis useful instead of just showing 'none'.

title: Add tests for completeness validation module
description:
The new analysis/completeness.py module needs test coverage:
- Test validate_completeness() with various missing configs
- Test format_completeness_report() output
- Test integration with validate CLI --strict flag

title: Fix critical data redundancy requirements in topology
description:
Redundancy analysis shows FAIL for postgresql-data, sqlite-databases, and photos-archive (2 copies vs 3 required). Either:
1. Lower min_critical_data_copies to 2 for databases (primary+replica is standard)
2. Or add a 3rd copy location for these datasets
Decision needed on what redundancy level is actually required.

title: Initialize git repository for version control
description:
Project needs git for:
- Proper bd daemon/sync functionality
- Version control of topology changes
- Tracking catalog updates over time
Run: git init && git add . && git commit -m 'Initial commit'
